description: Which eligible persona takes a part, and whether it is adequate. Exact eligibility first; then, for a part whose form names a builder, the builder the settings' forms map names; otherwise a Choice over the eligible personas, then a Noul on the chosen persona's adequacy. The adequacy line is 0.5, provisional, with no measured basis, until calibration replaces it.
question: Which eligible persona takes this part, and is it adequate?
basis: The adequacy line of 0.5 is a starting value with no measured basis. Calibration on a labelled set replaces it.
subject: the part, with the kind the act decision read for it

eligibility: the persona is on the roster the settings name, and its file carries a ratified declaration
the persona is not the user
where the part names a capability, the persona is recorded against that capability in the register the settings name
an unknown persona name is refused, never matched to a near name
where the part names no capability, every persona that meets the first two rules is eligible

where the part's kind is verdict-or-review, no persona in the group of the persona that did the work the part calls to account, read from that work's own dispatch record; where no record names that persona, no persona is chosen and the part goes back to the parent
facts_for_the_choice: each candidate's declared goal and what it declares it does
the task's stage, read by the stage read
for a build part, its form, which names the builder through the settings' forms map
never_facts: who sent the part, its persona or its group: the pending file records the sender, and no decision reads it
any group a kind is paired with
a candidate's group, except in the verdict-or-review eligibility rule

choice.instructions: This is one part of a piece of delegated work, given as `part`, with the kind of act it asks for and the task's stage. Each option is a persona with its declared goal and what it declares it does. Which persona's declared goal and acts cover this part best? Judge them as declared, not the persona's name.

form_builder.asked_of: a build part whose form decision read code or model, at, above or below its line
form_builder.rule: the persona the settings' forms map names for that form, where it is eligible; no Choice and no adequacy Noul are asked

adequacy.asked_of: the persona the Choice ranks first
adequacy.instructions: This is one part of a piece of delegated work, given as `part`, and one persona's declared goal and acts. Can this persona do this part within its declared goal, without the part asking for work its goal does not cover?

line_rule: A persona is adequate when the adequacy Noul's probability of yes is at or above the line.

outcomes.answer: none adequate, with the eligibility rule that emptied the set
outcomes.route: no persona is chosen; the part goes back to the parent

outcomes.when: the forms map names no eligible builder for the part's form
outcomes.answer: none adequate, with the reason the map gave no builder
outcomes.route: no persona is chosen; the part goes back to the parent as a finding

outcomes.when: the forms map names an eligible builder for the part's form
outcomes.route: the dispatch goes to this persona unless the parent overrides
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, which an override withdraws

outcomes.when: the adequacy Noul is at or above the line
outcomes.answer: the persona the Choice ranks first
outcomes.route: the dispatch goes to this persona unless the parent overrides
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, which an override withdraws

outcomes.when: the adequacy Noul is below the line
outcomes.answer: the persona the Choice ranks first, marked below the line
outcomes.route: the dispatch goes to this persona unless the parent overrides. The brief's body says no persona was found adequate, with the adequacy probability and the line. The dispatch record marks the part below the line, with that probability, the line and its version

outcomes.when: the request fails or times out
outcomes.route: the parent chooses the persona; the record says why

records: its adequacy probability, or that the forms map chose it

calibration.measure: agreement with labels naming an acceptable set of personas, on the held-out half; whether withholding the stage moves a choice
calibration.minimum_held_out: 10 parts, with every persona the set claims to cover appearing as an acceptable answer in both halves
